description: Batch 143 regression queries for Java VarHandle/JMM ordering, structured concurrency cancellation ownership, ServiceLoader SPI discovery, and classpath/module-path linkage debugging.

queries.query: volatile은 visibility만 보장하고 atomic increment는 아닌데 VarHandle acquire/release와 CAS loop를 언제 써야 해?
queries.notes: Should retrieve the VarHandle/JMM ordering primer because the query asks acquire/release, CAS, and atomicity boundaries.

queries.query: CompletableFuture fan-out에서 parent timeout 후에도 child task가 계속 돌면 structured concurrency의 scope ownership과 sibling cancel로 어떻게 고쳐?
queries.notes: Should retrieve the structured concurrency primer focused on lifetime ownership, not a generic CompletableFuture map.

queries.query: ServiceLoader lazy loading 때문에 provider jar 누락이 첫 요청에서 터지지 않게 META-INF services와 module provides uses를 어떻게 검증해?
queries.notes: Should retrieve the ServiceLoader SPI primer because the query asks Java discovery and startup validation details.

queries.query: 로컬 컴파일은 되는데 배포 fat jar에서 NoSuchMethodError가 나고 module path split package도 의심되면 jdeps와 dependency tree로 어떻게 좁혀?
queries.notes: Should retrieve the classpath/module-path playbook because the query combines fat jar shadowing and split package resolution.
